No.50/1/2025-EOC(CVO)
Government of India
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
Department of Personnel & Training
*****

North Block, New Delhi
Dated the 31st July, 2025
Subject: Appointment of Shri Ajay Kumar Jaiswal, IRSME(2008) as CVO, NCL, Singrauli.

The Competent Authority has approved the appointment of Shri Ajay Kumar Jaiswal,
IRSME(2008) as CVO, Northern Coalfields Ltd. (NCL), Singrauli under the Ministry of Coal
with pay at level 13 (Rs. 1,23,100 – 2,15,900/-) of the pay matrix, for an initial period of 3 years
from the date of assumption of charge of the post or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

(P. P. Singh)
Under Secretary to the Government of India
Tel. No. 23092589

Ministry of Coal
(Shri Vikram Dev Dutt, Secretary)
Shastri Bhawan,
New Delhi

1. The Chairman, Railway Board, Ministry of Railways, Rail Bhawan, New Delhi with the
 request to relieve the officer immediately to take up his new assignment.
2. The Secretary, Central Vigilance Commission, Satarkta Bhawan, GPO Complex, Block-
 A, INA, New Delhi-110023.
3. Shri Ajay Kumar Jaiswal, IRSME(2008) through the Chairman, Railway Board, Ministry
 of Railways.
4. PS to MOS(PP)/ PSO to Secretary(P)/ PPS to EO/ Dir(SM)/ DS(MM).
5. AD(OL) for providing Hindi version.
6. Guard File.
